epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase deliverable readiness ratio from 85% to 100% by resolving API slice failures
epics.tocConstraintRef: API Slice Task Execution and Status Transition Pipeline
requirements: R1: Debug and patch the underlying exception causing API Slice tasks (e.g., 8502067e, 72ec0f54) to fail repeatedly
R2: Ensure pipeline recovers from SYSTEM_STALLED state to process the final 2 project features

slices.title: Patch API Slice Execution Failures
slices.jtbd: When implementing the pipeline fix for this epic, I want to correct the execution logic for API Slice tasks, so that the project cycle can finish successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a set of API Slice tasks in a queued or failed state
When the task execution pipeline processes them
Then the tasks must transition to successfully resolved without errors
And the SYSTEM_STALLED flag must be cleared if all tasks pass
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce API slice execution error rate from current baseline to 0%

slices.title: Verify API Slice Pipeline Execution and Readiness Progression
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to add unit and integration tests verifying task state transitions, so that future regressions in the falsification pipeline are prevented.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a test environment with the updated API slice execution logic
When a mocked failed API slice task is reprocessed
Then the integration test must assert the task resolves successfully
And the test must assert the deliverable readiness ratio increments past 85%
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase integration test coverage of the API Slice execution path to 100%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce queued idle time for critical PR review and wishlist compilation tasks from >4 hours to <5 minutes
requirements: R1: Resolve the queue processing bottleneck preventing PR review fallback and wishlist compilation tasks from advancing

slices.title: Patch Queue Processing for Stuck Tasks
slices.jtbd: When implementing queue unblocking for this epic, I want to patch the state evaluation logic for stuck pipeline tasks, so that the workflow continues without manual intervention.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given tasks (e.g., PR review fallback, wishlist compilation) stuck in queued status for over 4 hours
When the queue processing daemon evaluates them
Then the tasks must transition to a processing state
And subsequent pipeline stages must resume execution
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease pipeline task state transition delay to 0 hours

slices.title: Verify Task Queue Unblocking Mechanism
slices.jtbd: When implementing QA for this epic, I want to write unit and integration tests for queue state evaluations, so that tasks do not get permanently stuck in a queued state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an automated integration test with mocked PR review and wishlist tasks in a queued state
When the queue unblocking logic is triggered
Then the test must assert that the tasks move to the processing state
And the test must assert that the idle timer is correctly evaluated
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase test coverage of queue stagnation recovery paths to 100%
